author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: four open star circles in the reference's layout (large top-right, hub centre-left, small bottom-left, smallest bottom-right) joined by straight links that stop on the rims. A first candidate with r3/r2 bottom stars was rejected because they filled in to dots at 48px, like the rejected drawing, which drew links through dotted circles.
omissions: Star sizes are compressed (r5, r6, r4, r3) so every star keeps a visible opening at 48px; the hub is about as large as the top-right star because three links need more than 8 units between their rim points.
drawing_plan: Hub ring of four r6 arcs about (20,22) through link points at offsets (5,-3),(3,5),(-5,3); stars r5 (37,11), r4 (10,38), r3 (39,39); links end on the rim points facing the hub.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'waypoints'/'share-2': circles joined by straight links ending on the rims.
